senses.gloss:
ईर् €2 Ā. (ईर्ते^1, ईराञ्चक्रे, ऐरिष्ट, ईरितुम्, ईर्ण); also €1 P. (p. p. ईरित)
—1 To go, move, shake (trans. also).
—2 To rise, arise or spring from.
—3 To go away, retire.
—4 To agitate, elevate; raise oneʼs voice.
 €10 U. or Caus. (ईरयति, ईरित) —1 To agitate, throw, cast;
 Śi. 8. 39; discharge, dart, hurl; ऐरिरच्च महाद्रुमम् Bk. 15. 52; R. 15. 20.
—2 To excite, prompt, urge; क्षेमंकरेऽर्थे मुहुरीर्यमाणः Bk. 12. 6.
—3 To cause to rise, produce.
—4 To utter, pronounce, proclaim, say, repeat; Māl. 1. 25; इतीरयन्तीव
 तया निरैक्षि N. 14. 21; Śi. 9. 69; Ki. 1. 26; R. 9. 8; निबोध चेमां
 गिरमीरितां मया.
—5 To cause to go, set in motion, move, shake; वातेरितपल्लवाङ्गुलिभिः
 Ś. 1; अपरागसमीरणेरितः Ki. 2. 50; Śi. 8. 20.
—6 To draw towards, attract; उद्धतैरिव परस्परसङ्गादीरितान्युभयतः
 कुचकुम्भैः Śi. 10. 32.
—7 To employ, use.
—8 To bring to life, revive.
—9 To elevate. ━To raise oneself (Ā.).
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20260605. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/250.
